short_description: Report generation taking longer than usual
description: Monthly sales reports are taking 45 minutes to generate instead of the usual 10 minutes.
symptoms: slow report generation, high CPU usage on reporting server
root_cause_notes: Missing database index on report query after recent schema migration.
resolution_notes: Added missing index. Report generation time back to normal.
work_notes: Checked query execution plan. Found full table scan due to missing index.
close_notes: Schema migration checklist to include index verification step.
